reason: Independent pre-implementation review required an exact matching definition, an exact simultaneous-reference support definition, and disclosure that 50 ms was selected from the same validation tracks.

official_evaluation.matching: deterministic maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching identical to Exp07 and Exp08

adaptive_validation_disclosure.result_scope: descriptive result on the adaptation validation set

simultaneous_reference_support.simultaneous_reference_instance: an annotated boundary instance whose exact sample position has reference multiplicity greater than one for the same boundary type
simultaneous_reference_support.support: number of those reference instances selected by the official one-to-one matching, calculated separately for onset and offset
simultaneous_reference_support.acceptance: treatment support must be greater than or equal to N16 control support for onset and for offset

corrections.zero_gap_integrity: Two N16 candidates with the same boundary type, private channel, and sample are impossible; any observed zero gap must fail the evaluation.

timing_metrics.signed_delay: prediction sample minus reference sample for each official matched pair
timing_metrics.causal_delay: the Exp07 latency metric: only non-negative signed delays are retained
timing_metrics.reported_summaries: counts plus p50 and p90 in samples and milliseconds; causal maximum is also reported

attribution_guard: Suppressed control candidates and their anchors may be described by their original control matching status, while the causal contribution of one suppression to net TP loss must not be claimed because complete one-to-one rematching can reassign candidates.
